instruction: Get Mux to repair the jammed door between the back room and the bar.

target.reason: The instruction wants the door repaired, but the page offers no repair action and none of the available end states (holding an item, being in a room, or having said something) captures a repaired door. Nothing Mux can be made to do or hold results in the jammed door being fixed.
